dataSourceInstructions:
Use the solar_panels_kb table in the dbo schema. Use only the following columns:
- "id": unique identifier of a knowledge item (INT)
- "knowledge_key": name of a knowledge item, also a unique identifier (STRING)
- "knowledge": the knowledge item
knowledge items are queries by either "id" or "knowledge_key". "knowledge" will be returned.
userDescription: This data source is used to get solar panels domain knowledge, prior to solving any user prompt to a query
